Use case: historical-scene. Generate one wholly NEW photograph-like1870s Paris aerial albumen scene, LANDSCAPE4:3 intended2048x1536. LOCK every water/land contour, orientation, perspective and full canvas extent of input1. NO zoom, crop, mirror, rotate, reframing, camera change or conventional NotreDame aerial-postcard layout. No horizon/sky inserted. The cathedral is a SMALL incidental landmark, not a large hero building: entire cathedral footprint about6-7percent image WIDTH at most, roughly130-145pixels in2048width. Absolute spatial structure in final2048x1536: P1 Cite-island WEST confluence tip(553,1029)=(.27,.67). P2 cathedral FOOTPRINT center(1024,983)=(.50,.64), not spire tip: small NotreDame entirely centered there. P3 THIN north river branch centerline atx1024,y860=(.50,.56). P4 same thin north branch centerline x1638,y722=(.80,.47). P5 left-bank/main-river corner atx819,y1321=(.40,.86). P6 BROAD main Seine centerline x1843,y1106=(.90,.72). The six coordinates are placement constraints only, never visible text/dots. North branch is a very NARROW winding ribbon, only about2.3-4percent image HEIGHT thick around the middle/right, versus the much broader southern MAIN RIVER about12-16percent image HEIGHT. Do not make the two branches equal in width. North ribbon runs from left(.0,.79) diagonally upward toward right(1,.46). Broad main river runs from lower-left(.0,.80) toward right(1,.66), with its left-bank bend at(.40,.86). The island is the exact long LENS-shaped land wedge between them: blunt west confluence tip at(.27,.67), broadens toward middle, CONTINUES OUT OF FRAME beyond right edge; do not show a closed eastern island tip anywhere in frame. Mainland city fills the upper image and south-bank city occupies bottom edge. Shapes/widths follow the reference pixels, not a memorized Paris picture.

Style: a convincing real old-camera high aerial albumen print, monochromatic warm sepia, faint yellow-paper tint, subtle fine film grain and very slight vignette, optical softness in distant roofs, natural daylight, no HDR/painting/engraving/CGI/model look. Build1870s roofs/streets strictly on LAND and river texture/boats on WATER, no cartographic color blocks. Small correct Gothic NotreDame at P2 has two west towers, long nave, tiny1859Viollet-le-Duc crossing spire. Old Hotel-Dieu remains beside its parvis/south-bank side (before1878 demolition), modest stone bridges at plausible reference crossings, narrow streets, many roofs, restrained chimney smoke and a few very small period steam boats/barges/moored craft. No bridge or church dominates the foreground. NO cars, modern buildings, EiffelTower, completedSacreCoeur, neon, recognizable faces, text, signs, numbers, lettering, logos, watermark, grid, marker dots, P labels, paper edge or frame. The reference red dot becomes the little cathedral site, not a red object. Entire canvas is the reference geography from the original high camera; it must not be zoomed in for architectural detail.
